sourceInstructions: <root xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/sqlserver/2004/07/adventure-works/ProductModelManuInstructions">AI-generated fictional demo instructions. Not validated engineering or safety instructions. Touring-1000. Fictional assembly demonstration for Touring-1000 model 34, using the Yellow, 46 representative product 954 (BK-T79Y-46). Scope is inspection of supplied subassemblies and final bicycle assembly.<Location LocationID="50" SetupHours="0.1" LaborHours="0.5" MachineHours="0.0" LotSize="1">Work Center 50 - Subassembly. Estimates are fictional demo assumptions. Inferred subassembly center: receive and visually check the representative bicycle's supplied assemblies before final assembly.<step>Check the finish and visible condition of 1 EA <material>HL Touring Frame - Yellow, 46 (Product Number FR-T98Y-46)</material>; its supplied frame BOM includes the fork.</step><step>Inspect 1 EA each of <material>Touring Front Wheel (Product Number FW-T905)</material> and <material>Touring Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-T905)</material> for visible damage and free rotation.</step><step>Check 1 EA each of <material>HL Headset (Product Number HS-3479)</material>, <material>HL Touring Handlebars (Product Number HB-T928)</material>, and <material>HL Touring Seat Assembly (Product Number SA-T872)</material> for visible damage before fitting.</step></Location><Location LocationID="60" SetupHours="0.15" LaborHours="2.0" MachineHours="0.0" LotSize="1">Work Center 60 - Final Assembly. Estimates are fictional demo assumptions. Final assembly center: fit the representative product's direct BOM components and make simple functional checks. This center appears in the historical routing.<step>Support 1 EA <material>HL Touring Frame - Yellow, 46 (Product Number FR-T98Y-46)</material> in an <tool>assumed bicycle assembly stand</tool>. Fit 1 EA <material>HL Headset (Product Number HS-3479)</material> at the steering assembly and check that it turns freely.</step><step>Fit 1 EA <material>HL Touring Handlebars (Product Number HB-T928)</material> at the steering assembly and 1 EA <material>HL Touring Seat Assembly (Product Number SA-T872)</material> at the frame's seat tube. See the overall arrangement in illustration <diag>100341</diag>.</step><step>Fit 1 EA <material>Touring Front Wheel (Product Number FW-T905)</material> at the front fork and 1 EA <material>Touring Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-T905)</material> at the rear of the frame. Check that both rotate freely; see illustration <diag>100341</diag>.</step><step>Fit 1 EA <material>HL Bottom Bracket (Product Number BB-9108)</material> and 1 EA <material>HL Crankset (Product Number CS-9183)</material> at the frame's crank area, then fit the BOM-listed 1 EA <material>Touring Pedal (Product Number PD-T852)</material>.</step><step>Fit 1 EA <material>Front Derailleur (Product Number FD-2342)</material> and 1 EA <material>Rear Derailleur (Product Number RD-2308)</material>; install 1 EA <material>Chain (Product Number CH-0234)</material> in the drivetrain and check for free movement.</step><step>Fit 1 EA <material>Front Brakes (Product Number FB-9873)</material> at the front and 1 EA <material>Rear Brakes (Product Number RB-9231)</material> at the rear. Check their visible alignment and operation.</step><step>Inspect the completed demonstration assembly for visible damage, secure fittings, wheel clearance, steering movement, and drivetrain movement. Set aside any assembly with a concern for review.</step></Location></root>
processNotes: The historical record shows product 954 at work center 60; the preceding subassembly inspection at center 50 is inferred, not a documented routing requirement.
Manufactured subassemblies are assumed to arrive complete; this draft does not invent their internal construction. The direct BOM lists each component as 1 EA, including the touring pedal.
variantNotes: The representative uses yellow size 46 frame 887 (FR-T98Y-46). Yellow sizes 50, 54, and 60 use frames 888 (FR-T98Y-50), 889 (FR-T98Y-54), and 885 (FR-T98Y-60), respectively.

Blue sizes 46, 50, 54, and 60 use frames 890 (FR-T98U-46), 891 (FR-T98U-50), 892 (FR-T98U-54), and 893 (FR-T98U-60), respectively. Do not substitute the representative yellow frame or its yellow paint for a blue variant.
All listed variants use front wheel 821 and rear wheel 829 and share the other listed direct components at 1 EA each. No variant-specific wheel substitution is shown in the snapshot.
The blue size 60 catalog description is specific to that variant; its appearance should not be assumed for the yellow representative.

Released the illustrated workstation edition: Touring bicycle assembly overview. Matched numbered component legends to the operating steps and adopted the Manufacturing Hub document layout.

100341.title: Touring bicycle assembly overview
guidance: Support 1 EA HL Touring Frame - Yellow, 46 (Product Number FR-T98Y-46) in an assumed bicycle assembly stand. Fit 1 EA HL Headset (Product Number HS-3479) at the steering assembly and check that it turns freely.

Fit 1 EA HL Touring Handlebars (Product Number HB-T928) at the steering assembly and 1 EA HL Touring Seat Assembly (Product Number SA-T872) at the frame's seat tube. See the overall arrangement in illustration 100341.

Fit 1 EA Touring Front Wheel (Product Number FW-T905) at the front fork and 1 EA Touring Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-T905) at the rear of the frame. Check that both rotate freely; see illustration 100341.
